## Checklist before requesting review

- [ ] Problem statement is clear and specific
- [ ] Success metrics have numeric targets (not just "improve X")
- [ ] Scope has both "In Scope" and "Out of Scope" sections
- [ ] Figma link is added (if design exists)
- [ ] Open questions are listed (even if unanswered)
- [ ] `catalog-info.yaml` lifecycle field reflects current stage
- [ ] New feature? Root `catalog-info.yaml` targets list updated
